The multiplayer is completely broken. The mechanics prevent any kind of co-op gameplay. It feels like two people are each playing a single-player game. And if one player is significantly higher in level, the other just ends up watching. Apart from that, this game is completely buggy. The basic idea of Megabonk in co-op is fantastic. But the implementation at launch is poor. I’ll check back in six months and hope I can update my review then. For now, though, I don’t recommend it.

别买别买别买，局内每把会给你代币，代币用来解锁两个建筑，一个是开背包栏位的，不开的话局内默认2武器位2卷轴位，另一个建筑是开成就菜单用的，实际上这俩都是恶心你的。 想要解锁新武器/卷轴/强化/英雄/皮肤？那你就去开主城里的宝箱，宝箱怎么来？打一把给你开2 3次吧，开来的是超级大混池，刚才说的所有需要解锁的都给你放里面，一次抽3到4个不同东西的碎片，每个东西需要至少15个合成，幽默完了，你搁这让我玩皇室战争呢？ 局内更是一坨大的，宝箱开10个9个绿色，急头白脸攒半天金币过去开个绿色加10移动速度纯幽默。 一个标榜合作的游戏，局内的所有地图资源都是不共享的，包括基地里的建筑升级和资源（至少我没看到有共享提示，共享了属性你也看不到，因为没有属性面板），最离谱的是经验都不共享，他妈俩人进去打，升级都是自己升的，我请问了你合作在哪？ 纯幽默，优化垃圾我忍了，怪物种类少我忍了，各种bug我也忍了，进游戏发现你别说合作了，连路上的升级祭坛都是各人开各人的，你吃个磁铁就把全图的经验吸走了，队友没经验吃，纯幽默游戏，你这卖40？你卖10块我都不会捏着鼻子来玩的，别买别买别买！

I definitely can't recommend buying this game in its current state. The core gameplay is enjoyable and the game has a lot of potential, but the technical issues completely overshadow it. The unusually high GPU usage is concerning, performance is unstable, and the co-op mode - the main reason my friends and I bought the game - is often broken. Even when it works, the current balance makes the experience enjoyable for only one player. I simply can't understand how the developers considered this ready for a full release. It feels much closer to an Early Access title than a finished product. Pros -Fun core gameplay concept -Good potential if the technical issues are resolved Cons -Extremely high GPU usage (up to 80%) even when nothing is happening -Frequent crashes and inconsistent performance -Basically no graphics settings -Broken co-op/multiplayer with connection issues -Towers serve no purpose -Co-op progression is poorly balanced – the player who gets the most power-ups has all the fun, while everyone else ends up feeling like spectators. -Feels unfinished despite being a full release Once all these issues are fixed I have no problem changing my review, but until then I'm keeping it negative.

To be honest I am between suggest and don't suggest. you unlock stuff from 2 sources 1> random magic chests from killing bosses, last 3 chests I unlocked had next to nothing but all 22 before that had various shards. These are random and how you very very slowly unlock new weapons and characters. 2> acorns you gather by playing the game, these allow you to unlock buff that make future runs much more enjoyable. This section isn't as obvious and I wasted a TON of Acorns on random chest rolls before I stumbled into the tab that let me spend them for these. Sad but happy to know there there. The core gameplay is different then everything I saw on videos, pretty sure that was a recent update. You no longer defend the base, monsters couldn't care about it. Also there is no winning, only making it to the next round rinse repeat till you eventually lose. The number of rounds I have lost simply because I could not find the boss sits at about 1 in 5 or so, assuming I am looking the entire time. Many many times I find the boss in the last 2 minutes or so, which is ok since that's about when I want to trigger him, but it means there's to little time to do anything other then look for him. Simply makes the game feel way more rushed then I would like, and have yet to find any unlock to make the rounds longer. maybe a future mod. The gameplay look is very very repetitive, I don't mind that much but since new unlocks are random and take a long time to start unlocking (random shards from quests) it starts to get pretty stale. though I am still playing so not to bad and this kind of game is known for repetitiveness. Over all, I think it just scrapes buy as worth having, perhaps on sale, though the price point is cheap enough when I got it to not be bad.

Highly recommended! I even bought the game for friends so we could play together. It's a lot of fun, but there are currently some frustrating issues and design flaws that desperately need to be fixed: Deaths & Respawns: You shouldn't get the deathscreen instantly upon dying. A 3–5 second cooldown would be great to see what actually killed you. Also, mounts or enemies should absolutely never spawn directly inside the player (which has already ruined our 20-minute runs TWICE). Hit Feedback: Shots currently lack any impact – hit sounds and better feedback would make the game feel way less cheap. Bosses also need better visual clarity, as red attacks are often way too transparent and we over see them. UI & Menus: The menu is extremely confusing and inconsistent (e.g., quest claims after clicking it but has a claim button that is not needed at all, or missing progress bars for skins/puzzles and quest dont show a ! Symbol when finished & claimable so u need to click and search after every round.). Groups & Collision: You get kicked out of the group when returning to the lobby, thats really annoying if u are a group who just want to upgrade or unlock stuff... always re-invite. Please add a go to main menu with group option. When buying towers, you sometimes get pushed back and land right inside enemies (a 2-second no-collision grace period for players would fix this). Health Bar & Leaderboards: It’s often way too hard to notice when you are low HP until it's too late, we need a much more obvious low HP screen effect or sound. Finally, the leaderboards should show which character was played so we can see what the top players play. (just like megabonk does it) Great foundation, but with a bit of polish and bug fixing, it easily becomes a 10/10 - right now 7/10.

After spending over [b]30 hours in MegaBonk[/b], this game immediately felt familiar in the best way. Sineus Arena Survivors captures that same addictive [b]"one more run" feeling[/b] while still offering its own experience with different characters, abilities, items, and maps. It actually made me want to go back and play MegaBonk again after months, which says a lot about how enjoyable the core gameplay is. The game has only been out for a little over a week, so there's still plenty of room to grow, but it's already showing [b]a lot of potential[/b]. I don't expect it to replace MegaBonk, and it doesn't need to. It feels like [b]its own take on the genre[/b]. One feature I especially like is the [b]4-player co-op[/b]. Being able to play with friends is a great addition and something I really missed in MegaBonk. I honestly didn't expect to get hooked this quickly, but after my first few runs I kept thinking, "just one more." If you're a fan of [b]arena survivor games[/b], especially if you enjoyed MegaBonk, I'd definitely recommend checking it out.

So, after playing for a while and attempting many builds, the game falls short on a lot of promises. The towers do absolutely nothing, even upgraded. They have a health stat for some reason, even though they don't take damage. The minions also die in one hit no matter what their health ends up at. The tower defense isn't real, considering everything can just walk over all the terrain. The categories aren't real and until they make these things viable, its not really what they say it is. Its just a worse megabonk because the scaling isn't ludicrous.

This recommendation is contingent on the idea that this game is still being actively updated and is NOT a finished product, which it might be. The devs don't seem to have a youtube channel or any sort of webpage for updates and if they do, it's incredibly well hidden. They have a discord but I didn't feel like joining just to see if this game is being updated especially since I can't refund the game at this point. This game is fun to play but it needs more maps and it really needs an endless mode. The way it is right now, you do 3 waves and then get cut off right when it gets to the good part. The OP builds and crazy enemies at higher levels is part of what makes risk of rain 2 so fun and right now this feels like a knock off risk of rain demo. IF this is the game's completed state then I don't recommend it because it only has 2 maps and I've unlocked most of the characters in the game and weapons/upgrades. Honestly, can't recommend this game until it gets an endless mode, and if it doesn't get an update at least on the steam page I'll be changing this review. And it needs more content in general to be considered a finished product.

Overall, the game itself is really fun and has a super addictive "one more run" gameplay loop. Stacking up artifacts, choosing weapons, and playing with friends in the 4-player co-op mode feels awesome and chaotic in the best way possible. The core combination of a 3D bullet heaven and real-time base defense gives it a unique spin that immediately hooked me. However, there is still plenty of things missing, so the game feels more like it's in an early stage rather than being a fully polished release. As you progress, the difficulty increase is nice, but the game desperately needs better balancing and more depth to its systems. Here is what I would love to see in future updates to give the game actual longevity: Rewards for faster stage clear: Right now, there is no real incentive to optimize your build for speed. Adding special rewards or currency bonuses for beating stages under a certain time limit would add a great layer of replayability. Better progression and unlocks: More unlocks or significantly harder unlocks would be nice. The challenge disappears too quickly. Endgame content: As it stands, if you have unlocked everything, there is simply not much to do. Once you clear the current content and max out the collection screen, the motivation to keep playing drops significantly. The foundation here is brilliant, and the developers have been pushing out patches to fix things like UI clunkiness and death screens, but it needs more fuel to keep players around. I will definitely be waiting for a future updates to jump back in. Rating: 7/10 – Fun core loop, but currently lacks endgame depth. Definitely worth checking out, but hopes are on the next big content drops.

It's fun but it's an early access game and should be advertised as such. It's seemingly designed with controllers/steam decks in mind but plays *fine* on keyboard and mouse, if not clunky. The sound design isn't great, the music is a weird dubstep, and it's missing core features like upgrading the settlement in the main lobby. As for the game itself, it's bootleg Megabonk which all in all, is pretty disrespectful considering this game is $1 more than Megabonk is. The base-building aspect of the game is gimmicky and not very well thought out. You can only build three buildings, of which are randomized, and they give you randomized buffs to choose from when you upgrade so each run is unpredictable and there is no "tower defense" to this game. If you get a specific building and upgrade it, you get wooden pillars around your "base" and there's select locations you can build towers that barely help you at all. If you haven't played Megabonk and this interests you, you'll probably have a better time playing that. If you have played Megabonk and you're looking for something that's "the same but in a different font" type deal, this might be for you. Just be aware of it's shortcomings. I wouldn't be surprised if this game is a quick cash grab and immediately drops support in the coming days/weeks.

[h1]圣火守望者：共筑防线简评[/h1] [h2]个人游玩与体验[/h2] 一款可以多人联机合作的类幸存者游戏，游戏人物场景采用的是3D建模，不过我感觉建模还是有一点粗糙，画风偏卡通风格，个人感觉有的像卡通版魔兽世界的感觉。 游戏的主要玩法是非常经典的类幸存者玩法，不过制作组在里面加入很多新的玩法，游戏里面有建筑系统，可以根据自己要选择的bd方向来选择要修建的建筑，比如可以选择修建提升自身属性的建筑，还可以选择修建提升召唤物属性的建筑，而且还可以修建防御塔来帮助我们击败敌人，不过这个防御塔是有时间cd的，在游戏的地图上面还有大量的收集资源，还可以花钱开宝箱，宝箱的物品有稀有度的划分，都是随机获得的，抽到金色传说还是很爽的，游戏的内容很丰富，有大量不同能力的初始英雄可以选择，丰富的局内bd组合，还有无尽模式，甚至可以直接在游戏里面选择敲钟来提升难度，游戏的可玩性还是很强的，而且游戏战斗时候的背景音乐很带感，玩起来很有感觉。 不过游戏的ui设计的很一般，我找了很久都没有找到退出键，而且局外养成太肝了，地图也少，玩到后面就感觉有些无聊了，推荐给喜欢这种画风和玩法的朋友去游玩体验一下。 欢迎加入:[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/xiaohongping] 小红瓶游戏评鉴组[/url]

[h2]【多人3D吸血鬼幸存｜旧瓶新酒趣味多，四人联机共斗爽】[/h2] 它的底子依旧是刷怪、生存、升级、构筑，但并没有只停在“又一款幸存者like”上，而是把地图探索、塔防、建造和多人联机合作都缝了进去。整体体验属于旧瓶新酒，框架不陌生，但玩起来确实多了不少变量和乐子，尤其是和朋友一起分工守家、外出捡资源时，爽感和混乱感都会明显叠加。 [h2]玩法[/h2] 玩家每局在怪潮不断涌来的压力下，一边战斗升级，一边搜刮资源、选择武器和强化，并建造塔楼、围墙等防御设施。游戏支持单人，也支持2-4人联机合作，不同角色有各自的成长路线和战斗风格，队伍里可以有人负责清怪守点，有人冒险离开基地去探索远处资源、祭坛和敌方巢穴。 每局节奏偏快，目标是击败首领、推进难度和生态群落，也可以继续挑战更高强度的无尽怪海。 [h2]特点[/h2] 它最有意思的地方，是没有把“吸血鬼幸存者”做成单纯站桩割草，而是强迫玩家动起来。离信标越远，风险越高，但奖励也越好，这让游戏不只是看数值滚雪球，还多了一层“贪不贪”的判断。 即时建造和塔防元素也让它和同类作品拉开了一点距离，玩家不只是堆武器、捡经验，还要考虑防线怎么搭、资源怎么用、队友之间怎么配合。多人合作算是本作的核心加分项，四个人一起打的时候，缝合出来的东西反而比单看每个元素更有味道。 [h2]需要注意的[/h2] 目前游戏整体框架已经站住了，但内容量和细节打磨还有继续扩充的空间。 玩家评价里也能看到类似“想要更多Boss、武器、地图”的反馈，说明它的核心循环好玩，但长期新鲜感还要看后续更新。另一个比较现实的问题是联机环境，野队大厅不一定稳定有人，想完整体验这套多人共斗设计，最好还是自备小伙伴。 [h2]购买建议[/h2] 如果你本来就喜欢类幸存者，尤其是有朋友能一起开黑，那本作已经值得直接入手，属于缝得比较聪明、玩起来也确实爽的那类。 要是你只打算单人玩，或者对内容量要求很高，也可以先观望后续更新和折扣。总体来说，这瓶子确实是老的，但里面装的新酒还挺上头，给予推荐！ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/36376191]快速简评，寻找合适你的游戏！→【老K的游戏购买指南】[/url]

This is a negative review, but I'll leave a thumbs up for now as I'd like to see this develope into something greater. The game is heavily inspired by Megabonk in several aspects and carries both the good and the bad with it. This game is however way easier to "break" and there appears to be no monster scaling at all in its current state. I broke the tipping point of going infinite in stage 2/3 within my first 5 games with little effort and not even unlocking full weapon/scroll slots. The "tower defense" part of the game was a big USP for me and I was sad to see it had quite literally zero meaning in the game. The voice acting is a bit bad but I can only imagine it's because it's a small studio which is okay. However the music is sick and I like some of the weapon/class designs although it could use some more descriptives as to what they actually do. For example - Ogre stew does what exactly? I've played it and I still haven't noticed it among my other skills. The game has a lot of potential but it still needs a ton of work, it still feels like a demo. I'd be mad if I had spent more money on it than I did, the price tag right now is okay for what you get and if the developers balance and fix some stuff. It's for sure a good investment if you want a couple of hours of fun - it's some good bang for your buck that will hopefully evolve into something greater. If developers read this, here are some things you should change: 1. Allow skipping animation on opening chests, it's quite annoying opening 3+ chests having to watch the full animation before you can open the next one. 2. Work on the endgame, don't walk into the trap of AFK "gameplay" which already exists in megabonk. You've got great potential in countering this with the actual incorporation of your TD perspective. I've got plenty of ideas about this, feel free to contact me if you want new eyes on the project. 3. Balance, like I mentioned in the review, it's quite easy to go infinite as is, scaling needs to be overlooked. 4. Option to bind more keys and adjust the UI.
